name: @lambdasafe/pi-extensions
description: Lambdasafe Pi extensions: workspace-swarm (HTTP group chat / agent bus per workspace), ringfence (default-deny guardrail around the workspace) and ask-jev (schema-shaped second opinions from a local LM Studio decision model).
